retrievalProfile.description: A satirical ensemble illustration featuring a central caricature statue surrounded by chaotic characters, framed by a thick red border and heavy slab-serif typography.
triggerTerms: heavy slab serif with horizontal gradients

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, highly detailed caricature of a decorated military figure stands on a pedestal, surrounded by a chaotic group of comedic characters, a car, and a motorcycle. The entire scene is set against a stark white background, enclosed by a thick red outer border. The top third is dominated by bold, red slab-serif typography with horizontal color banding.
coreVisualRelationships: Central vertical axis anchored by the statue
Radial arrangement of secondary characters around the base
Top-heavy typographic hierarchy balancing the bottom-heavy illustration
High contrast between the white negative space and the saturated red border
coreInvariants: Stark white background for the central composition
Heavy slab-serif display type with horizontal gradient fills

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical statue at 60% height; secondary characters clustered at the bottom 40%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central military statue on a stone pedestal.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top red title, moves down the central statue, then circles clockwise through the peripheral characters.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the central cluster to emphasize the chaotic detail.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Blue and Tan (character clothing and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the border and title; varied, earthy, and muted tones in the detailed illustration.

letterConstructionRules: Horizontal color banding/gradients within the letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature a 3D extrusion effect or heavy drop shadow to pop from the white background
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for titles paired with small, clean sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif structure and square terminals.
Provides the necessary geometric slab-serif weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a detailed caricature illustration of a chaotic military scene with a central statue on a pedestal, surrounded by a car, motorcycle, and various comedic characters, all on a pure white background with a thick red border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, centered, extra-bold slab-serif text at the top in red with horizontal white gradient stripes across the middle of the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the red border thick and consistent?
Does the text have horizontal color banding?
Is the central figure a caricature statue?

mustRedesign: Do not use existing magazine logos
postGenerationChecks: Verify slab-serif weight is 'Black' or 'Extra Bold'
Ensure the red border is solid and encloses the entire frame
Confirm the illustration style is hand-drawn caricature
recipe.reuseFormula: Central caricature cluster + White background + Thick red frame + Heavy slab-serif header with horizontal banding.
